name: Exploded Assembly
desc: An exploded axonometric of a machine that never finishes coming apart — flanges, gears, springs and nuts drift off a dash-dot centreline and drop back together while the whole assembly turns on its axis under ballooned leader lines.

energy.doc: explosion travel + glow (at max the assembly flies fully apart)

density.doc: number of parts in the stack (4–10)

spin.doc: how fast the assembly turns on its own axis

x.doc: assembly centre x as canvas fraction

y.doc: assembly centre y as canvas fraction

style.doc: aesthetic: draughtsman's plate on drafting paper / machined anodized metal with specular bands / cyan schematic on navy / hatched patent engraving / dark X-ray — outline and glow only, every part transparent

seed.doc: deterministic seed — regenerates the whole part stack
